mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with clear skies observed near the Verona Area High School under the light of a waxing crescent moon.

On September 10th, Verona police were called to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress. Officers located a suspect, nineteen year old Luis Aragon-Zaring, who was found in possession of a handgun and shell casing. The suspect was treated for an injury sustained during the attempt and will face charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with activities including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the farmer's market.
On September 10th, local officers responded to a serious incident involving a residential burglary and a weapon on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in the arrest of a suspect.
While Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, you can look forward to them opening today at 10:00 AM.
